title: Fisiologista do Futebol Feminino
description:
Buscamos um(a) Analista de Contabilidade Pleno para trilhar um caminho glorioso com o Botafogo 彡

Este cargo tem como objetivo atuar diretamente no monitoramento, análise e interpretação de dados físicos e fisiológicos, contribuindo para a tomada de decisão técnica, o planejamento do treinamento e os processos de prevenção, recuperação e retorno ao treino/jogo, sempre em integração com a comissão técnica e o staff multidisciplinar.

E aí, curtiu? Venha jogar junto em nosso time

SAFBotafogo #ÉDiferente


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar o monitoramento fisiológico, físico e de carga interna e externa das atletas durante treinos e jogos;
  • Operar e analisar dados provenientes de sistemas de GPS, com ênfase em Catapult, garantindo qualidade, consistência e interpretação adequada das informações;
  • Planejar, executar e interpretar avaliações físicas e fisiológicas, utilizando os equipamentos de avaliação da VALD Performance, de acordo com os protocolos do NSP;
  • Atuar no controle, organização, análise e visualização de dados, com produção de relatórios claros e objetivos para suporte à tomada de decisão da comissão técnica e coordenação;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de termografia aplicada ao esporte como suporte ao monitoramento, prevenção de lesões e acompanhamento de processos de recuperação, respeitando critérios técnicos e clínicos;
  • Integrar-se de forma contínua com as áreas de preparação física, fisioterapia e medicina, contribuindo para processos de prevenção, recuperação, retorno ao treino e retorno ao jogo (RTP);
  • Apoiar o planejamento do treinamento a partir da análise dos dados fisiológicos, das avaliações e do contexto competitivo;
  • Garantir a padronização de processos, registros e fluxos de informação do Núcleo de Saúde e Performance.

Requisitos e qualificações

Como requisitos básicos, você deve ter:

  • Graduação em Educação Física ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de sistemas de GPS aplicados ao futebol, com ênfase em Catapult;
  • Experiência no uso de equipamentos de avaliação da VALD Performance (ex.: força, potência, assimetrias e controle neuromuscular);
  • Conhecimento em termografia aplicada ao esporte.
  • Capacidade de análise, tratamento e visualização de dados, utilizando ferramentas como:
  • Excel (nível intermediário a avançado)
  • Power BI ou ferramentas similares de visualização de dados
  • Familiaridade com softwares e plataformas de monitoramento e controle de carga;

Você se destaca, se tiver:

  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Fisiologia do Exercício, Ciências do Esporte, Treinamento Esportivo ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência prévia como fisiologista ou função correlata em futebol, preferencialmente em ambientes de alto rendimento;
  • Vivência comprovada com monitoramento de carga por GPS, especialmente com Catapult;
  • Experiência prática com equipamentos de avaliação da VALD Performance (ex.: força, assimetrias, potência, controle neuromuscular);
  • Conhecimento e experiência no uso de termografia aplicada ao esporte;
  • Capacidade de análise, tratamento, controle e visualização de dados, com domínio de ferramentas digitais e elaboração de relatórios.
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com o futebol feminino, compreendendo suas particularidades fisiológicas, incluindo:
  • Influência do ciclo menstrual no desempenho, carga e recuperação
  • Diferenças de resposta à carga, fadiga e risco de lesão
  • Aspectos específicos de prevenção e monitoramento em atletas mulheres
  • Experiência em trabalho integrado com equipes multidisciplinares, com boa comunicação e alinhamento institucional.
  • Cursos em Fisiologia do Exercício aplicada ao Futebol;
  • Cursos ou formações específicas em monitoramento de carga, GPS e análise de desempenho;
  • Capacitação no uso de Catapult e/ou VALD Performance;
  • Certificações ou formações complementares em termografia esportiva.

Informações adicionais

Nossa história começa em 1894, com o Club de Regatas Botafogo, e se desdobra em 1904, com o surgimento do Botafogo Football Club. Posteriormente, a fusão entre eles, deu origem ao Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas, 1942. O Clube é reconhecido como o "Glorioso", por seus feitos e conquistas ao longo de toda a sua trajetória no futebol, e conta com uma torcida apaixonada a nível nacional e internacional. Até os dias de hoje, o Alvinegro é o clube que mais cedeu jogadores para a Seleção Brasileira em Copas do Mundo, contribuindo diretamente para três títulos mundiais do Brasil, quando foi base das seleções campeãs em 1958, 1962 e 1970.

O Time da Estrela Solitária é por natureza um verdadeiro celeiro de craques e conta com uma coletânea incomparável de ídolos. Os maiores de todos os tempos vestiram a camisa do Mais Tradicional. Entre suas taças e glórias em campo, o Botafogo é Tricampeão brasileiro e campeão da Libertadores, e segue escrevendo sua história vitoriosa nos gramados.

SAF BOTAFOGO 彡

Liderada por John Textor, a SAF Botafogo assumiu o controle do futebol do Mais Tradicional em março de 2022, sendo pioneira na constituição de um Clube-Empresa no país.

Tendo um projeto ambicioso e profissional como direcionamento, a SAF busca construir um novo Botafogo, forte, vitorioso e inspirador, juntamente com seus verdadeiros donos, os seus torcedores apaixonados.

Afinal, ninguém muda o mundo sozinho, e aqui somos mais de 9 milhões de cooperados.

description:

Como Cientista de Dados Sênior você:

  • Terá como principais desafios:
    • Desenvolver e implementar modelos de IA Generativa (LLMs) para chatbots, buscas inteligentes e personalização de serviços;
    • Realizar fine-tuning de modelos para contexto governamental brasileiro;
    • Estabelecer práticas de IA responsável e trustworthiness;
    • Liderar transferência de conhecimento;
    • Mentorar equipe de cientistas de dados e engenheiros de ML.

Para assumir esse desafio você precisa ter experiência com: 

  • Formação em Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação, Matemática ou áreas correlatas;
  • 10+ anos de experiência em Machine Learning e Ciência de Dados;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Experiência hands-on com modelos de linguagem (LLMs, Transformers);
  • Deep Learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch);
  • Python para Ciência de Dados (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn);
  • MLOps e pipelines de ML em produção;
  • Experiência em projetos de alto impacto;

  • Certificações em ML/IA (AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Azure AI Engineer, Google Professional ML Engineer);
  • Experiência com fine-tuning de LLMs (GPT, BERT, T5, etc.);
  • Publicações científicas em conferências ou journals de IA/ML;
  • Experiência como professor ou facilitador de treinamentos;
  • Conhecimento de ética em IA e vieses algorítmicos;

title: Comprador(a) Sr
description:
A Vibra Energia busca um(a) Comprador(a) Especialista de Óleos Básicos e Infraestrutura para integrar a área de Insumos Estratégicos, atuando como protagonista na condução de processos de aquisição de alta complexidade, grande impacto financeiro e relevância estratégica. Este(a) profissional será responsável por liderar negociações críticas, estruturar modelos estratégicos de fornecimento e impulsionar iniciativas que assegurem competitividade, sustentabilidade e resiliência da cadeia de suprimentos de Óleos Básicos e Derivados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar negociações estratégicas e de alta complexidade com fornecedores nacionais e internacionais de óleos básicos, derivados e serviços de infraestrutura, garantindo condições comerciais diferenciadas e relações de longo prazo.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar estratégias de compras avançadas, baseadas em inteligência de mercado, análises de sensibilidade, projeções macroeconômicas, volatilidade de preços e avaliação detalhada de riscos.
  • Gerenciar contratos robustos, conduzindo todo o ciclo de vida contratual (elaboração, negociação, implementação, renovação e encerramento), garantindo compliance, governança e aderência às políticas corporativas.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas internas (produção, logística, engenharia, planejamento, negócios e financeiro), influenciando decisões táticas e estratégicas relacionadas à cadeia de valor.
  • Monitorar KPIs e indicadores críticos de performance, utilizando análises avançadas para propor planos de ação, prevenir riscos e impulsionar melhorias estruturais.
  • Desenvolver um portfólio resiliente de fornecedores, promovendo diversificação, qualificação técnica, programas de desenvolvimento e mitigação de dependências críticas.
  • Realizar análises profundas de viabilidade e modelagens de cenários, considerando TCO, impactos tributários, custos logísticos, riscos geopolíticos e variações cambiais.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e consultiva, disseminando melhores práticas, liderando iniciativas estruturantes e contribuindo para a evolução do processo de Suprimentos.
  • Participar e dar suporte em auditorias internas e externas, assegurando rastreabilidade, transparência e integridade dos processos de aquisição.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência consolidada em compras estratégicas e negociações complexas, preferencialmente nos segmentos de óleos básicos, lubrificantes, petroquímico, óleo e gás e infraestrutura de armazenamento (tancagem).
  • Domínio avançado em técnicas de negociação, gestão de categorias, desenvolvimento de fornecedores e gestão de contratos de alta criticidade.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com experiência em planejamento estratégico, análise de dados, leitura de cenários de mercado e modelagem econômica.
  • Proficiência avançada no Pacote Office, especialmente Excel e BI para modelagens robustas, e PowerPoint para apresentações executivas.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ERP (preferencialmente SAP) e ferramentas de gestão de suprimentos.
  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação será diferencial.
  • Vivência comprovada em compliance, gestão de riscos e auditorias aplicadas a processos de compras.
  • Conhecimento de operações portuárias: noções de estiva, desestiva, tipos de cargas (granel líquido e contêineres).
  • Inglês avançado obrigatório; outros idiomas são diferenciais.

Competências e Características Desejadas

  • Visão estratégica, pensamento estruturado e capacidade de influenciar decisões de alto impacto.
  • Habilidade em conduzir negociações complexas, com forte poder de persuasão e relacionamento interpessoal.

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico – Bradesco – extensivo a dependentes
  • PAE - Auxílio financeiro oferecido no caso de dependentes filhos(as) e/ou enteados(as) com deficiência intelectual

  • Oferece coaching e feedback para cada funcionário da assistência técnica e/ou líderes de equipes de assistência técnica; fornece avaliações de desempenho e oportunidades de crescimento profissional.
  • Fornece o primeiro nível de suporte aos técnicos de serviço que exigem assistência; encaminha as necessidades de suporte técnico para resolução quando necessário.

  • Desenvolve e/ou revisa orçamentos para confirmar a exatidão antes de se comunicar com os clientes; fornece atualizações sobre o status dos reparos e qualquer mudança em planos ou programações.
  • Participa de atividades de melhoria contínua ao revisar, alterar e melhorar processos alinhados com as metas organizacionais/expectativas dinâmicas do cliente
  • Monitora o status de reparos em aberto com técnicos da oficina; resolve questões que influenciam a conclusão do plano de reparo no prazo cotado aos clientes.
  • Monitora metas e alvos para a filial; mede, revisa e mantém os níveis superiores de satisfação do cliente.
  • Resolve problemas do cliente relacionados a garantias do distribuidor e da Cummins; desenvolve relacionamentos sólidos com clientes-chave por meio da comunicação profissional e frequente.

description:
Quer ser um diretor escolar de excelência? Vem com a gente
Assumir a direção de uma escola vai muito além de ocupar um cargo: é uma oportunidade única de impactar vidas e deixar um legado na educação. Aqui no Grupo Salta, oferecemos a chance de iniciar uma jornada que vai expandir ainda mais o seu potencial. Ao fazer parte do nosso time de diretores, você vai liderar uma das escolas do maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil, inspirando as vidas da sua comunidade escolar e deixando a sua marca no cenário educacional do nosso país.
Juntos, podemos construir um futuro em que a educação seja dinâmica, transformadora e fortalecida em uma cultura de excelência. Vamos transformar histórias: a sua, a nossa e a da educação de todo o Brasil.
O primeiro passo para a excelência começa aqui. Vem com a gente e faça parte desse legado
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Gestão da equipe pedagógica e administrativa: Supervisionar e orientar as equipes pedagógicas e administrativas, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e garantindo o alinhamento com as metas institucionais;
Gestão do calendário escolar, projetos e eventos pedagógicos da escola: Garantir o cumprimento do calendário escolar, considerando excelência, qualidade técnica, comunicação e alinhamento à cultura da escola, de todos os projetos e eventos pedagógicos;
Atendimento aos responsáveis: Manter um canal de comunicação eficaz e acolhedor com os pais e responsáveis, garantindo o esclarecimento de dúvidas, resolução de problemas e a construção de uma relação de confiança com a comunidade escolar;
Desenvolvimento de equipe: Promover a formação contínua de professores e funcionários, garantindo alinhamento às metas da escola e atualização pedagógica constante, além de realizar avaliações periódicas do desempenho docente, com feedback e suporte para aprimoramento;
Captação e retenção de alunos: Atuar em estratégias de marketing educacional, elaborando planos de captação e fidelização de alunos, e promover uma experiência positiva para as famílias, consolidando a escola como referência de excelência na região;
Inovação e excelência: Incentivar a integração de tecnologia e práticas inovadoras no ensino, acompanhando tendências educacionais e implementando melhorias contínuas no currículo e na metodologia da escola.

Formação superior completa em Pedagogia, Educação ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência sólida em gestão escolar, preferencialmente em instituições de grande porte;
Forte capacidade de liderança, comunicação e tomada de decisão;
Cursar ou ter cursado pós-graduação em Gestão Escolar é um diferencial.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que te espera no dia a dia:

  • Implementar, administrar e manter equipamentos, servidores e serviços de infraestrutura;
  • Participar do desenho de arquiteturas para suportar o crescimento de aplicações existentes e o desenvolvimento de novas soluções;
  • Atuar no suporte técnico às equipes de desenvolvimento e testes, auxiliando no troubleshooting de aplicações;
  • Garantir a alta disponibilidade das aplicações e sistemas, realizando monitoramento contínuo e ações corretivas proativas ou reativas;
  • Monitorar ambientes utilizando ferramentas como Zabbix, CloudWatch, New Relic, Grafana e Prometheus;
  • Documentar processos internos, arquiteturas e fluxos de infraestrutura;
  • Avaliar e sugerir a adoção de novas ferramentas e tecnologias que contribuam para redução de esforço operacional, otimização de recursos, escalabilidade e confiabilidade;
  • Garantir a segurança da infraestrutura e a continuidade do negócio, por meio de atualizações constantes, políticas de segurança e rotinas de backup;

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos alguém que:

  • Pensa e age a partir das perspectivas dos clientes. Demonstra interesse e curiosidade de conhecer os clientes, seus comportamentos e preferências para atender e superar suas expectativas;
  • Demonstra compromisso permanente em aprender, ensinar e desenvolver, contribuindo para um ambiente descontraído, respeitoso e colaborativo, incentivando a diversidade;
  • É flexível para se desprender de paradigmas e modelos mentais existentes. Busca soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis, para criar vantagens competitivas para o negócio, equilibrando os interesses econômicos, ambientais e sociais.

Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial:

  • Residir em São Paulo ou Rio de Janeiro;
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas da Informação, Engenharia de Software e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com Cloud AWS e ambientes On-Premises baseados em VMware;
  • Domínio de ambientes Linux/Unix/BSD, com ênfase em distribuições baseadas em RedHat;
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código IaC (Ansible e Terraform);
  • Administração de servidores web e aplicação (Apache, Nginx, Tomcat, PM2 e IIS);
  • Administração de Windows Server (Active Directory e GPOs);
  • Conhecimentos em infraestrutura de redes (Firewall, Load Balancer, roteadores e storage);
  • Administração básica de bancos de dados (MySQL, SQL Server, Elasticsearch e MongoDB);
  • Conhecimento em scripting (Python, Shell Script e/ou PowerShell);
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura e escrita);

É diferencial:

  • Certificações Linux (LPI ou RedHat), Cloud AWS ou DevOps;

No Grupo Ri Happy, a maior rede varejista de brinquedos do Brasil, a gente acredita que crescer pode (e deve) ser divertido. Aqui, ser SUPER é mais do que um valor é o nosso jeito de encantar, surpreender e transformar o mundo ao nosso redor.

Pode vir com sua essência, sua história e seu brilho único. Por aqui temos:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Efetuar o recebimento da venda realizada, de acordo com as formas de pagamento;

  • Acompanhar os indicadores de vendas, como TM, PA, Conversão, NPS e outros;
  • Atuar intensamente nas redes sociais, gerando conteúdo, acompanhando posts e buscando seguidores;
  • Manter a loja limpa, seções organizadas, abastecidas e precificadas;

Você já se imaginou levando sorrisos para milhares de famílias pelo Brasil?

Somos o maior grupo varejista de brinquedos do Brasil, com mais de 300 lojas entre franquias e operações próprias, e impactamos milhões de famílias todos os anos. Somos um ecossistema de negócios que se complementam, oferecendo experiências únicas para crianças, famílias e para quem constrói essa história com a gente. Mas nosso verdadeiro tamanho não está só nos números.

Nossa cultura é o que nos torna especiais, e ela é construída sobre cinco valores fundamentais, que chamamos de SUPER. Eles são a base do nosso jeito de ser e de agir. Com esses valores nós somos quem somos, e somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos.

Com quase 3.000 vozes, talentos e histórias conectadas por um mesmo propósito, transformamos o mundo por meio do brincar. Afinal, no Grupo Ri Happy a diversão é levada a sério, porque acreditamos que trabalhar com leveza, colaboração e criatividade abre espaço para que cada um brilhe e se desenvolva com o que tem de melhor. Um lugar onde você pode ser quem é hoje e se tornar quem quer ser amanhã.

Isso tudo nos faz sermos considerados um Great Place to Work, um reconhecimento que reflete um ambiente onde é possível crescer, se desenvolver e sentir orgulho do caminho que está sendo construído. Afinal, a magia acontece de dentro para fora

title: Gerente de Projetos
description:
Sobre Nós:

A Engineering é uma companhia global de Tecnologia da Informação e consultoria especializada em Transformação Digital, presente na Europa, América do Norte e América Latina. Há mais de 40 anos no mercado ajudando as empresas a desenvolverem e evoluírem a sua vantagem competitiva por meio de uma abordagem orientada a negócios, colocando a Inteligência Artificial no centro de sua operação, explorando ecossistemas e plataformas digitais e adotando o mindset API First para reconfigurar e inovar a cadeia de valor, gerando novos modelos de negócios e uma melhor experiência do cliente.

Com mais de 1000 colaboradores no Brasil, a Engineering é uma das maiores e mais inovadoras empresas presente no País e considerada um dos melhores lugares para se trabalhar.

Desafio:

Liderar projetos estratégicos de Inteligência Artificial e Dados, garantindo planejamento, execução e encerramento com entregas dentro do prazo, qualidade e alinhamento aos requisitos do negócio. Atuar como elo entre áreas de negócio, times técnicos e fornecedores, navegando entre modelos tradicionais (cascata) e frameworks ágeis, assegurando conformidade com governança de TI, governança de dados e segurança da informação.

Qual será o seu papel?

  • Gestão de projetos ponta a ponta: Definir escopo, cronograma, orçamento, riscos e dependências, com relatórios executivos e comunicação estruturada para stakeholders.
  • Facilitação e governança: Conduzir reuniões de acompanhamento, garantindo cadência, clareza de objetivos e registro das decisões;
  • Controle de qualidade e prazos: Monitorar riscos, mudanças e aceite formal dos entregáveis (funcionais/técnicos), assegurando transição para operação/sustentação;
  • Tradução de requisitos: Converter demandas do negócio em histórias de usuário (Agile) ou EAP (cascata), validando critérios de aceitação;
  • Gestão de fornecedores: Acompanhar cronogramas, escopo, SLAs e marcos, equalizar propostas e garantir recursos e acessos necessários para execução;
  • Monitoramento e métricas: Criar dashboards no Azure DevOps com KPIs para apoiar priorização de backlog e gestão da carga de trabalho dos times internos e externos.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Experiência em projetos de IA e Dados (ingestão de dados, dashboards, Power Apps, sistemas com IA e automações);
  • Domínio de metodologias PMBOK e frameworks ágeis (Scrum, Kanban), com flexibilidade para transitar entre abordagens;
  • Vivência em gestão de fornecedores e contratação por marcos (milestones);
  • Habilidade em comunicação executiva, gestão de stakeholders, negociação e resolução de conflitos.

title: analista ambiental
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.
A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.
A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.
Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.
Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Atuar no processo de planejamento, desenvolvimento e monitoramento das ações previstas no Plano de Sustentabilidade, contribuir com a implantação focando na construção de indicadores de saúde e sustentabilidade, e gerenciamento dos resíduos dos serviços de saúde – PGRSS.

Ensino Superior Completo em Biologia, Ecologia, Geografia, História, Engenharia Florestal, Ambiental, Agronômica e Segurança do Trabalho ou Gestão Ambiental;
Especialização cursando na área de ciências ambientais, saúde pública e coletiva, administração, segurança do trabalho, sistema de gestão integrado (saúde, meio ambiente e segurança), educação ambiental e responsabilidade social.;
Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na área ambiental.

title: tecnico de hemoterapia
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Participa dos processos de trabalho de unidades hemoterápicas (bancos de sangue), atuando no ciclo do sangue e em procedimentos de infusão de hemocomponentes e derivados para fins terapêuticos.
Realiza os processos de captação e triagem clínica de doadores de sangue.
Realiza a coleta e o processamento do sangue, o controle do armazenamento e da expedição e as provas sorológicas.
Recebe, prepara e processa amostras biológicas sanguíneas e auxilia as equipes de saúde nos procedimentos hemoterápicos.
Atua no controle da qualidade de reagentes, produtos, insumos e equipamentos.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Técnico Completo em Hemoterapia
Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovadas na área.

A Cultura Inglesa acredita na inclusão e diversidade. Esta vaga faz parte do nosso programa de inclusão e é exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Controlar o fluxo de pessoas na unidade;
  • Acompanhar o processo de adaptação dos estudantes que acabaram de chegar à instituição;
  • Dar orientação quanto ao cumprimento de horários e regras específicas do recinto;
  • Informar sobre mudanças nas salas de aula e outras dependências da escola;
  • Receber os alunos no horário de entrada;

  • Zelar pelas regras, procedimentos, regimento da instituição e cumprimento de horários

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio completo ou cursando
  • Não é necessário ter experiência anterior

  • Assistência médica – SulAmérica

  • Seguro de vida – SulAmérica

A Cultura Inglesa é uma das marcas mais premiadas do mercado de idiomas. Com mais de 90 anos de história, estamos presentes em mais de 100 unidades espalhadas por 8 estados e o Distrito Federal. title: Financial Reporting Jr Analyst
description:
About The Role
As a Financial Reporting Jr Analyst at VTEX, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of consolidated financial reporting. You will support and lead various financial reporting processes, engage in technical accounting matters, and collaborate on projects that enhance efficiencies and decision-making within the organization. This position provides an excellent opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and make a significant impact on VTEX's financial reporting standards.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare monthly consolidation accounting, elimination entries, and supporting working papers, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Assist with the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes, ensuring compliance with Group accounting policies and standards.
Assist with month-end close procedures, including comprehensive analysis of variances and account reconciliations.
Assist with the preparation of technical accounting memorandums, ensuring alignment with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), and other accounting frameworks (such as US GAAP).
Support external and internal audits by providing timely and accurate responses to audit queries and maintaining complete documentation.
Support the execution and documentation of SOx internal controls.
Continuously evaluate and improve accounting processes and reporting, driving efficiency and accuracy.
Stay updated on IFRS and other accounting frameworks (such as US GAAP) reporting developments and implement changes as required.
Participate in special projects, such as ERP implementations and other financial transformation initiatives.
About The Team
The Consolidation and Financial Reporting team is responsible for consolidating the financial results of VTEX subsidiaries and preparing internal and external financial statements in compliance with the applicable accounting standards and SEC requirements. The team collaborates closely with Controllership, Investor Relations, and FP&A, ensuring timely and accurate financial information. At VTEX, you will thrive in a proactive environment where results are celebrated and innovation is encouraged. You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that drive business growth and innovation. You will join a team that values excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning. This role offers a chance to make a tangible impact while growing your career in a supportive and dynamic environment.
Who You Are
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Production Engineering, or a related field;
2+ years of experience in Big 4/public accounting or mid-to-large public/global companies.
Knowledge of IFRS, BRGAAP, and financial reporting standards, including group consolidation and foreign exchange. US GAAP and other accounting frameworks knowledge is a plus.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., FCCS, Narrative, PBCS).
Analytical and systemic thinking to design simple solutions for complex problems.
Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
Advanced oral and written communication skills in English;
Proactive, adaptable, and self-motivated with strong organizational skills.
Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders and work collaboratively in a flat organizational structure.
Demonstrated writing and argumentation skills, with proven experience in preparing technical memos, explaining processes and analyzes in a clear and structured way is a plus.
About VTEX
VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the enterprise digital commerce platform where global brands and retailers run their world of commerce. VTEX is trusted by more than 2,400 customers, such as AbInbev, Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola and Whirlpool, with over 3,200 active online stores across 38 countries*.
Founded in the year 2000, VTEX has a history of being unstoppable. Completely against the odds, VTEX is leading a high-tech industry and positioned above market giants. We are building an extraordinary future with more than 1,400 employees scattered across 18 locations in 12 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia.
At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together.
Benefits
Annual profit-sharing program and equity eligibility
Health, dental, and life insurance with national coverage provided by VTEX
Annual budget for professional development in Tech
Language development incentive program (English, Spanish, Portuguese)
Flexible meal allowance
Extended parental leaves
Child-care assistance
Flexible work schedule and remote-first culture
Financial assistance to build your work-from-home setup
Wellness program
Free shipping on 1000+ VTEX stores

title: Coordenador de implantação
description:
This position will be hired on an outsourcing basis, with an attractive salary and benefits package.

Job Description

Position Mission

  • Lead the deployment of telecommunications products and services by aligning internal demands with customer objectives, developing detailed implementation planning, distributing activities, and managing resources to ensure delivery within defined timelines and budgets. Proactively mitigate risks while ensuring full compliance with internal and external quality, safety, and acceptance procedures.
  • Guarantee the effective execution of all field activities, directly supporting subcontractors and technical teams in the resolution of operational challenges, and ensuring full compliance with safety, quality, and customer acceptance procedures.

Key Responsibilities

Internal Coordination

  • · Validate internal demands and ensure compliance with internal and customer standards.
  • · Plan deployment activities based on resources, priorities, and project needs.
  • · Align periodically with internal teams on priorities and timelines.
  • · Update KPIs, project progress, and reports daily in internal and customer systems.
  • · Conduct audits and site visits to ensure safety, quality, and acceptance standards.

Customer Alignment

  • Align internal efforts with customer goals, negotiating priority changes when needed. Monitor the progress of customer-side prerequisites such as infrastructure readiness, transmission availability, and access authorizations.
  • Participate actively in meetings, conferences, and events—both internal and customer-driven—whether in person or online, especially those involving compliance and audit processes.

Subcontractor Management

  • · Ensure field activities are executed as planned, providing on-site support, removing blockers, and escalating issues to meet delivery targets.
  • · Monitor subcontractor teams daily, tracking progress, adjusting priorities, and escalating issues to ensure deadlines and budgets are met.
  • · Act as a technical coach, guiding subcontractors to ensure safe, compliant, and effective execution.

Governance and Compliance

  • Timely issuance of all reports, documents, and tickets as required by internal and customer procedures, following the approved formats and content standards.
  • Ensure that all stakeholders (internal teams, subcontractors, and customers) comply with legal, regulatory, and procedural requirements—particularly in the areas of compliance, security, and auditing.

Field Execution Oversight

  • Be the primary operational lead responsible for ensuring all deployment activities are executed in the field as planned.
  • Anticipate and resolve execution challenges through direct interaction with subcontractors and technical supervisors.
  • Monitor work quality, field conditions, safety protocols, and scheduling adherence on a daily basis.

Requirements

  • Technical degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or related fields.
  • Associate (Technologist) or Bachelor's degree is highly desirable.
  • Advanced English
  • 5+ years of experience in the telecom industry.
  • 2+ years of experience as a deployment supervisor or senior deployment analyst.
  • Experience working in or for a telecom carrier or vendor.
  • Proven experience in coordinating 10+ field teams simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Basic knowledge of project management (certification is a plus).
  • Understanding of wireless and/or bearer network engineering (installation) fundamentals.

If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you

description:
Description

We are looking for an enthusiastic and results-oriented Customer Success Specialist for our B2B clients. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the entire customer journey, from initial product implementation to long-term success and growth. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of strong technical aptitude, account management expertise, and excellent communication skills to ensure our clients achieve maximum value from our complex product suite.

  • Manage a portfolio of accounts, focusing on retention and identifying opportunities to upgrade client plans as per their growing needs.

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • 1-2+ years of experience in a similar Customer Success, Implementation, or Account Management position;
  • Proven experience of setting up a complex B2B product with functional logic (e.g., Odoo, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar large-scale ERP/CRM/SaaS products);
  • Customer-oriented and responsible attitude;
  • Fluent English both written and spoken;
  • Excellent presentation and account management skills.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Fixed schedule: Monday–Friday, from 9am to 6pm GMT-5;
  • Opportunity to work fully remotely;
  • Inclusive international environment;
  • Compensation in USD;
  • Responsive management interested in your growth and long-lasting cooperation.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Overview
WELCOME TO SITA
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward—we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
Are you ready to love your job?
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
About The Role & Team
Responsible for managing end-to-end Network implementation projects. This role bridges technical and project management expertise to ensure successful delivery, coordinating between technical teams, vendors, GEO project management team, customers etc to address challenges and achieve project goals
What You Will Do
Acts as the primary contact during the execution of the project
Plans and execute implementation projects, ensuring scope & timelines are met
Builds and owns the delivery roll out plan in consultation with different project team members
Mobilizes internal delivery resources
Identifies and mitigates project risks related to Network services deployments
Coordinates cross-functional technical teams to resolve project roadblocks
Participates in pilot migration and implementation calls
Drives post implementation/ migration reviews
Ensures proper documentation and handover of technical deliverables to operations teams.
Documents lessons learned for future references.
Builds and shares project progress dashboards
Qualifications
WHO YOU ARE
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Networking, or a related field.
Relevant certifications in networking or project management (e.g., Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), Project Management Professional (PMP), ITIL, Lean Six Sigma, MS Project, Power point).
Proven and solid experience in managing and executing Network implementation/ migration projects.
Experience coordinating cross-functional technical teams and managing customer/vendor relationships.
Track record of identifying and mitigating project risks
Experience in managing project timelines, budgets, and scope, with a focus on successful project delivery.
In-depth knowledge of Network services and delivery processes.
Ability to drive projects and liaise with multiple teams and stakeholders.
Knowledge of technical documentation and change management practices.
What We Offer
We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.
Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning
Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of ServiceThe Administrative Assistant (Admin & Finance) reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference, supporting the administrative and finance implementation of projects and initiatives. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the Operational Team of UN-Habitat in Rio de Janeiro and HQs.
Work LocationRio de Janeiro, RJ, Brazil
Expected durationSix (6) months, with possibility of renewal
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. To meet with greater demand for projects' implementation, the office of Rio de Janeiro is looking for an Administrative Assistant (Admin & Finance) that will be focusing on Brazil initiatives. The professional will be asked to assist the office team by contributing to the administrative and financial implementation of projects and initiatives. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Administrative Assistant (Admin & Finance) reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Administrative Assistant (Admin & Finance) will support the implementation of the projects in Brazil, with the following responsibilities: a. Support the administrative and financial implementation of projects and initiatives, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and procedures, under supervision. b. Assist in budget planning, monitoring, and revisions, including tracking expenditures against approved budgets. c. Under supervision, process and follow up on financial transactions, such as payments, advances, reimbursements, and vendor contracts. d. Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial and administrative records for projects and operations. e. Organize and archive all documents and information relevant to project administration. f. Support the team through audits and other administrative and financial compliance checks. g. Supporting the monitoring of financial reporting timelines and contribute to the preparation of financial reports for internal and external stakeholders. h. Liaise with programme teams, finance, and operations units to resolve administrative and financial issues under supervision. i. Support audits and financial reviews by ensuring availability and organization of required documentation. j. Write official letters in Portuguese. k. Assist with travel requests for the technical team, including travel requests and mission reports. l. Be responsible for keeping information organized and accessible. m. Participate in missions as requested. n. Carry out other activities requested by the Head of Office and/or Program Officer within the framework of this consultancy, without prejudice to fulfilling their responsibilities. m. Prepare reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. n. Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisor. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Administrative Assistant (Admin & Finance) shall support the Program Officers in the proper planning and management of programmes' implementation related to the office's project portfolio, according to the stated responsibilities. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation
Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Public Administration, Administration, Economics, or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience
A minimum of three (3) years of experience in program' implementation and projects in public administration or international organizations, admin and financial issues, and/or related areas is required.
Demonstrated experience in administrative and finance is required.
Work experience within the United Nations System is desirable.
International experience is desirable, particularly in the field of international cooperation for development, urban development, and project management. Skills
Good computer skills in Office Package (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) are required.
Mastery of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is required.
Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and/or Spanish is desirable.
Additional InformationTravel details: The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. title: SDR (Sales Development Representative) BRA (Remote)
description:
A Sales Development Representative (SDR) plays a critical role in driving revenue growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers for the company's products or services. As the first point of contact in the sales process, SDRs are responsible for creating a strong pipeline of opportunities that fuels the success of the sales team.
This role involves researching and segmenting target markets, identifying decision-makers within organizations, and using multiple outreach channels—such as cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn messaging, and social media engagement—to connect with prospects. SDRs must understand each prospect's industry, challenges, and goals to effectively tailor their pitch and communicate the value proposition of the company's offerings.
Beyond initiating contact, SDRs qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring that account executives receive prospects who are ready and able to engage in meaningful sales conversations. They also schedule discovery calls, product demos, or meetings, and document all interactions in the company's CRM system to maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline.
An effective SDR is goal-driven, resilient, and curious, able to handle rejection while staying motivated to meet or exceed key performance metrics such as outreach volume, response rates, and conversion rates. Collaboration with the marketing team is also essential, as SDRs often provide feedback on campaign performance and prospect insights to improve lead generation efforts.
Success in this role requires exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, strong active listening abilities, and the capacity to quickly learn and articulate the benefits of complex products or services. SDRs who excel not only open doors for new business but also build lasting relationships that can lead to long-term customers and sustainable company growth.

title: Senior Operations Geologist
description:
* Please ensure attached resume is in English language *
The Operations Geologist ensures all wells are drilled safely, stays in sync with all regulations, and efficiently to meet defined well objectives in accordance with the Statement of Requirements (SOR) and meets all expectations of the New Wells Common Process. This delivery requires collaboration and effective communication across bp Subsurface and Wells teams. A strong HSSE attitude and commercial awareness are essential, with a focus on safe, efficient, and cost-effective practices.
Essential Experience And Job Requirements
Degree in Geology, Geophysics or Geoscience or related field
Seasoned professional of relevant industry experience, most of which should have been gained in a geological operations environment
Industry experience in the areas of well planning and operations geology, well-site geology. Working knowledge of drilling operations, pore pressure, mudlogging is desirable
Experience with formation evaluation tools (LWD/MWD, wireline logging) and basic interpretation of rock/fluid types and borehole conditions
Proficiency in monitoring drilling progress and interpreting real-time geological data.
Ability to coordinate mobilization of geological contractors and service providers.
Proficiency with geological reporting and data management tools, with experience integrating digital solutions into workflows.
Geological, seismic and petrophysical log interpretation using workstation skills is beneficial;
Strong written and verbal communication skills
The individual needs to have a collaborative team-first mentality, be self-motivated, with a strong ability to integrate across subject areas
Ability to lead the subsurface efforts in late design (D5-11) activities consistent with bp well planning process, leading the creation of the GOP prior to drilling, and the EOWR (End of Well Report) and required handover documents following TD.
In addition, it would be help if you had
Experience with Offshore Brazil exploration and development wells
Well Planning & Design
HSSE focus and ability to influence compliance standards for Safety and Operational Risks
Support well planning activities and construction of relevant NWS documents consistent with bp's Wells Common Process, WCD-SOR (Wells Concept Document, Statement of Requirements) D1-D8 Stage gates ( All process decision points are numbered D1-D11)
Assist in the creation of pre-drill risk registers and ensure mitigation and contingency plans are created for all geological risks
Ensure integration of well planning and operational activity through strong collaboration with key interested parties, NWS (New Wells Solutions) and Wells leadership
Liaise with project geologists and well engineers to define well functional specifications and casing points while defining operational success criteria and support scenario planning
Lead the construction of the GOP (Geological Operations Plan) ensuring all relevant information is contained in this document
Geological Operations
Lead the daily subsurface operations meeting with the Rig based subsurface entities (WSG, BioStrat, ML, LWD), present NDS (No Drilling Surprises), expected geology in subsurface hole section previews, and reviews
Participate in DWOP, LWOP, CWOP exercises, ensure that the speciality vendors are engaged early in the process, present material on NDS, expected geology for subsurface hole section previews, hole section reviews for the well.
Monitor real-time well data and perform geologic correlations; work closely with petrophysicists on LWD and wireline data, coring operations, and data transmission
Supervise and coordinate with the Wellsite Geologist, ensuring alignment on subsurface objectives, data quality, operational decisions and that all geological activities on the rig are properly managed.
Provide support to the wellsite geologist: daily and as needed ops call, provide up to date information and offset date, collaborate between Subsurface and Wells to ensure all well objectives are delivered safely.
Ensure efficient delivery of the data acquisition program, ensure Vendors Co-owners are delivering and receiving all required data and updates. SPA for Co-Owner communication and information dissemination.
Post Well
Support successful EOW Report completion ensuring the report meets the expectations of the New Wells Common Process
Ensure all data is finalised and electronically captures in the corporate regional data store and hard data copy is distributed accordingly to partners
Capture and document all post well key takeaways and share in appropriate NWD venues.
Support root cause analysis for any NPT event related to subsurface operations (Orange category) and ensure these findings are distributed through the appropriate venues and collaborators
Why join us
At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and high-reaching environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.
There are many aspects of our employees' lives that are meaningful, so we o8er benefits ) to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for bp. Please be advised that we do not require any forms of payment or course by applicants to be considered for open positions.

title: Delayed Coker Visbreaker Specialist
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Delayed Coker/Visbreaker Engineering Specialist to join the Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD).
OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.
Your primary role is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for refineries' delayed Coker and visbreaker, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support, benchmarking, and technology knowledge management
Key Responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Conduct comprehensive performance reviews of existing delayed coker/visbreaker facilities, and analyze KPIs related to operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly-owned and affiliates), and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in delayed coker/visbreaker technologies.
Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including troubleshooting, optimization, debottlenecking, revamp, and upgrade activities and provide detailed service reports for each support activity.
Drive performance improvement programs that enhance process safety, optimize manufacturing costs, and increase plant reliability for delayed coker/visbreaker units.
Develop and implement best practices and standards for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and maintenance, while ensuring alignment with industry standards and regulations.
Provide expert technical support to project teams and contractors for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and procurement activities.
Coordinate with other disciplines (process, mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical) to ensure optimal performance and integration of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
Conduct regular audits and inspections of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment to ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality regulations and standards.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and innovations for delayed coker/visbreaker improvement and optimization.
Minimum Requirements:
You will hold a Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
You will have a minimum of 15 years of experience across the refinery and/or petrochemical industry, with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in delayed coker/visbreaker specialty.
You will be able to optimize delayed coker/visbreaker operations, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
You will have comprehensive knowledge of delayed coker/visbreaker processes, equipment, and systems in refining and petrochemical industries.
You will have deep understanding of ASME Section VIII Divisions 1 & 2, ASME Section I, API-530, API-535, API-537, API-560, API-579, API-936, and NFPA standards applicable to fired equipment.
You will have Significant experience in inspection and failure analysis of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
You will have proficiency in basic and advanced NDE techniques related to delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
High level of proficiency in using software tools related to delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and design, such as Aspen Hysys, ANSYS, and HTRI.
You will have knowledge of remaining life calculations for heater tubes and refractory design and repair.
You will have excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to prepare and present technical reports to various audiences.
You will also have strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.
Working environment:
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Deputy Director, Operations
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us
Job Purpose
The Deputy Director, Operations & Engineering supports the Executive Director in leading technical operations, custodial services, and Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) collaboration within Howard University's facilities ecosystem. This role ensures that building systems, utilities, and maintenance programs operate reliably and efficiently while advancing service quality, preventive maintenance, and compliance. The Deputy Director provides operational leadership, supervises managers, and drives integration of engineering standards, custodial performance, and EHS protocols.
Supervisory Authority
Supervises managers and supervisors responsible for technical operations, custodial services, and environmental health & safety collaboration. Oversees contractors and service vendors engaged in facilities operations and maintenance.
Nature And Scope
Internal contacts include faculty, staff, students, and administrative offices to ensure high-quality facilities services. External contacts include contractors, vendors, and regulatory agencies, particularly those governing environmental health, safety, and building compliance.
Principal Accountabilities
Directs technical operations, including utilities, HVAC, electrical, mechanical, and life-safety systems.
Oversees custodial operations, ensuring service quality, cleanliness, and responsiveness.
Collaborates with EHS teams to ensure safe working environments, regulatory compliance, and risk mitigation.
Implements preventive and predictive maintenance programs to extend the life of University assets.
Ensures compliance with OSHA, EPA, fire/life safety, and related regulations.
Monitors contract performance for custodial and technical service vendors, ensuring adherence to SLAs and performance standards.
Establishes performance benchmarks and KPIs to evaluate operations, timeliness, and service quality.
Provides leadership in emergency response, disaster recovery, and continuity of operations for facilities systems.
Guides staff development, technical training, and succession planning for operations teams.
Performs other related duties as assigned.
Core Competencies
Strong knowledge of building engineering systems, custodial operations, and EHS compliance.
Demonstrated ability to lead large operational teams and technical service providers.
Analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on preventive solutions.
Commitment to operational excellence, service quality, and safety culture.
Ability to develop long-term strategies that balance financial sustainability with operational excellence.
Strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills with focus on accountability and innovation.
Commitment to service quality, timeliness, and the University's mission.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering, facilities management, or related field with 7–10 years of experience in operations and engineering management. Master's degree preferred. CEFP or equivalent technical credential strongly desired.

$145,000 - $150,000

Você será responsável por identificar e sinalizar com antecedência a necessidade de novas compras, contribuindo para a manutenção de um estoque equilibrado e sem rupturas.

  • Capacidade de negociação e pesquisa para encontrar as melhores soluções e fornecedores, com foco em otimização de custos e qualidade.
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal para interação eficaz com equipes internas e parceiros externos.
  • Comprometimento inabalável com a
    qualidade, agilidade e responsabilidade
    nas entregas e processos.

  • Foco em Resultados e Melhoria Contínua:

  • Flexibilidade e Adaptabilidade:
    Disposição para lidar com a dinâmica de um ambiente de startup em crescimento, abraçando mudanças e novos desafios.

Na
Burst Suplementos

colaboração, iniciativa e criatividade

melhoria contínua
, onde seu impacto será visível e celebrado.

title: MSF Access Executive Director
description:
Location:
Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur). Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration
: MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Deadline to Appl
y:

ts: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting
to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date
: Beginning of Q2 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF's 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF's International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

"Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work."

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF's access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access's mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED's role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director's primary responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability

  • Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access
  • Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget
  • Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director
  • Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee
  • Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access External Representation and Engagement
  • Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT
  • Steer MSF Access's overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders Internal Leadership Management
  • Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team
  • Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF's Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.
  • Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives
  • Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues
  • Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team
  • Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

  • Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities
  • Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF
  • Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities
  • Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis
  • Survey and analyze the external access landscape

REQUIREMENTS

  • 15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs
  • PhD or Master's degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.
  • Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF's medical humanitarian mission and operations.
  • Deep understanding of MSF's operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.
  • Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.
  • Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.
